'''Ein Truminn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Ein Truminn attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and served as a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], where he developed a rivalry with fellow officer Lieutenant [[Tanith Sorn]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Sorn was sent to the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay to greet [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who had been summoned to the ship by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] ''[[Onderian Raptor]]'' landed in the hangar and an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] individual emerged from it, and told Truminn that his name was [[Bail Antilles (Rebel Alliance)|Bail Antilles]] and that he and his crew were bounty hunters. However, the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[bridge commander]] detected a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] code that was being broadcast from the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and ordered Truminn and a group of crewmen to apprehend Antilles and his crew. However, the ''Raptor''{{'s}} crew opened fire on the Imperial officers and Antilles shot Truminn in the chest at point blank range, crtically injuring him.
